diagnostics.message: aws_ecs_service.this must wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.infrastructure_iam_role_vpc_lattice_policy when VPC Lattice is configured: creating the infrastructure role alone does not grant ECS the permissions needed to manage Lattice targets. Add this attachment to depends_on alongside the EBS attachment.

aws_ecs_service.ignore_task_definition must wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.infrastructure_iam_role_vpc_lattice_policy when VPC Lattice is configured. The role reference does not ensure its Lattice permissions have been attached before ECS configures the service; include this attachment in depends_on.

aws_ecs_task_definition.this waits for the additional task-role attachments but not aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.tasks_internal. Include tasks_internal in depends_on so consumers launching this task definition cannot race attachment of the generated task-role policy (including ECS Exec permissions). Referencing the task role itself does not wait for this attachment.
